referralPathway: Parents have their own right to request a determination for their child
A student is referred to the Chief Education Officer, who sets what assessments are required
From there the Minister refers on to medical, educational or social services agencies
The trigger is identification by the Chief Education Officer as having learning difficulties
Written informed parental consent gates specialised testing not routinely used by teachers
funding: Tuition at a public school is not charged to the student or the parents
The cost of an individual education plan is apportioned between the Ministry and the parent
The manner of that apportionment is left to regulations made under the Act
A student over 18 carries the parent's share of the apportioned cost
The apportionment, including non-educational costs, can be appealed to the Tribunal
outcomesEvidence: Enrolment counts by type of disability, not attainment: how many, not how well
Produced by the Corporate Planning Unit of the Ministry of Education
Annual, so repeated: the series is the Education Statistical Digests

funding: The cost of an individual education plan is apportioned between the parents and the Ministry
Where the Minister directs enrolment elsewhere, the Government pays the fees and other costs
The manner of that apportionment is left to the regulations
The apportionment is itself a decision a parent may appeal

funding: Funding is for schooling generally: a child of compulsory age gets free public education
Free means a waiver of tuition fees only, not textbooks, uniforms, supplies or transport
Textbooks and other essential resources are discretionary, subject to available resources

The Minister decides, on a medical officer's report and reports on the child's ability
At the far end the Minister may approve alternative graduation requirements

referralPathway: Signalling happens at the school, by the teacher and/or the head of school

The Inspectorate records an official referral commission and its procedures are not clear

For want of a placement commission, parents enrol the child at the school themselves
